verses.21:18: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقࣱۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

meaning: The root "dmg" primarily refers to a severe head wound that reaches the brain, considered fatal. It also describes a harmful palm-tree growth that must be removed.
